component.name: SilverScreen
component.summary: Native YouTube client that plays videos with MPV

description.p: SilverScreen is a native YouTube client for GNOME, built with GTK 4 and Libadwaita. Search YouTube or paste a video link, then play it through a built-in libmpv player or an external MPV install, with stream extraction handled by yt-dlp.
Supports both Wayland and X11 sessions through GTK 4.

ul.li: Search YouTube and open results directly in MPV
Optional sign-in for Home recommendations, subscriptions, and history
Queue, comments, ratings, SponsorBlock skipping, and Discord Rich Presence
